scope: Fresh source-informed reviewer wordings; become development regressions after use, not blind tests.

cases.question: Did Dain pay cash to acquire his Stadium Events?
cases.expected: Traded Atari collection and received money from other party; not simple cash buy.

cases.question: Was Battleship only an imagined missing game for Johnny?
cases.expected: Actually missing cartridge but owned box/manual;676withoutBattleship scenario is joke.

cases.question: Who lost the Burning Desire and Bachelorette auction?
cases.expected: Unlabelled turn does not securely identify bidder.

cases.question: Had Johnny finished Evil Within 2 or just bought it?
cases.expected: Bought both, finished first; sequel not played yet.

cases.question: What happened when Johnny checked the GTA Game Boy Color pager sticker?
cases.expected: Earlier absence corrected after checking box; different-sized inserts.

cases.question: Did the lottery discussion mean Johnny had hired cataloging staff?
cases.expected: Hypothetical wealth/collection scenario, no actual hires.
